summary: Iteration 5 (Hooked-model habit design) backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend (6/6 in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py): (1) POST /api/projects on a fresh throwaway account returns streak_event with keys {count, extended, is_milestone}; first-of-day extended=true and count>=1 and is_milestone=false; second same-day project returns extended=false with count unchanged. (2) POST /api/assets/generate (RUN ONCE, throwaway) returns all four required keys 'asset','newly_unlocked','streak_event','surprise'; asset.image_b64 payload is a base64 string >100 chars; streak_event shape correct; 'surprise' was null on this run (acceptable — ~25% chance); when non-null the test asserts type ∈ {credit,style,boost,praise} and that credit/boost increments bonus_credits by 1 (branch not exercised due to null). (3) Regression /api/usage returns {plan, generations_used, generations_limit, bonus_credits, counters, streak, unlocked, milestones}. (4) /api/brand-memory defaults {enabled:true, tone:'', keywords:[], colors:[]}. (5) /api/analytics returns a non-empty dict. (6) Brand memory still learns from POST /api/projects.brand_keywords (verified 'cozy'+'warm' learned). Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): (A) Welcome modal on a THROWAWAY signup shows both testIDs — welcome-start-button labelled 'Create my first brand →' and welcome-explore-button. Tapping welcome-start-button dismisses the modal and navigates to /agent with agent-idea-input pre-filled with 69 chars ('A cozy neighborhood plant shop with workshops and a warm, earthy vibe'). (B) Dashboard renders smart-nudge-card with contextual text ('5 more ideas to unlock the Spark Pack' + 'New idea' CTA) — tapping it navigates to /capture. (C) Dashboard quick action order verified via [data-testid^='quick-']: ['quick-ai-agent','quick-new-idea','quick-templates','quick-start-branding','quick-insights','quick-surprises'] — AI Agent is first. 'Streak' text visible on Home (Milestones region). (D) Regression on demo (demo@creatorforge.app / creator123): login via use-demo-button + auth-submit-button works; welcome-explore-button dismisses cleanly; Studio, Capture, Analytics, Brand Memory (memory-enabled-toggle present) all load; Incubator lists 3 seeded demo projects and tapping the first opens Project Detail (Bloom Florals) with Idea/Branding/Complete stages, Tasks, Brand and Refine sections. Full Agent stepper (running an image generation from UI) was intentionally NOT re-run — iteration-4 already verified it end-to-end and this iteration already consumed 1 image gen via backend test. RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents) still emitted — carry-over from iterations 1-4.

MINOR: the surprise branch in the backend is non-deterministic (~25%). If deterministic verification is desired later, consider an env-flag test hook (e.g. CF_TEST_FORCE_SURPRISE=1) so tests can reliably exercise credit/boost bonus_credits increment without needing multiple retries.
MINOR (server.py line 226): milestone days list (3,7,14,30,60,100) is duplicated near recompute_milestones — consider centralizing MILESTONE_DAYS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_streak() (line 213) correctly handles: same-day (extended=false, count preserved), yesterday (count+1), and non-consecutive (count reset to 1). is_milestone computed against 3/7/14/30/60/100.
server.py maybe_surprise() (line 238) correctly caps at 2/day, resets on date change, rolls ~25%, increments bonus_credits only for 'credit'/'boost' types via $inc — matches spec.
POST /api/projects and POST /api/assets/generate both persist streak update BEFORE returning streak_event, so the shape is authoritative for the client celebrate.ts hook.
Frontend Home computes nudge purely client-side via computeNudge(usage, projects) — no OS notifications requested (spec-compliant). Route target derived from nudge object.
Welcome modal gating uses a single storage flag 'cf_onboarded' — idempotent, does not re-show after dismissal via either button.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (welcome modal + pre-fill, smart-nudge-card render & navigation, quick action order, streak visibility, regression navigation across Studio/Capture/Brand Memory/Analytics/Project detail all pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-5 new response shapes on the backend: POST /api/projects and POST /api/assets/generate BOTH return 'streak_event' {count:int, extended:bool, is_milestone:bool}. Milestone days are 3/7/14/30/60/100 — a brand new user's first project will have count=1 and is_milestone=false. Quick actions on Home are in a horizontal ScrollView, testIDs {quick-ai-agent, quick-new-idea, quick-templates, quick-start-branding, quick-insights, quick-surprises} in that order. Auth screen testIDs unchanged (auth-email-input, auth-password-input, signup-name-input, toggle-auth-mode, auth-submit-button, use-demo-button, google-signin-button). Full Agent stepper flow (5 steps, 1 image gen) still works — do not re-run unnecessarily; iteration-4 report covers UI details. Demo account still has 3 projects seeded (Bloom Florals + others) and brand-memory carries 'premium'+'earthy' keywords from prior iters — expected.
